description: Scaffold the React application with Vite, Tailwind CSS, React Router, Lucide React, and Recharts. Set up project structure, theming (Propela Purple #5B2D8E, Poppins font), and localStorage data layer with seed data structure.
steps: Initialize Vite React project at /projects/sandbox/PropelaPlatform (use the existing directory - run npm create vite@latest with --template react, accepting overwrite for existing files)
Install dependencies: npm install react-router-dom lucide-react recharts. Install dev deps: npm install -D tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite

Configure Tailwind CSS: update vite.config.js to include @tailwindcss/vite plugin. Create src/index.css with @import 'tailwindcss' directive. Extend theme in tailwind config or use CSS variables for: colors (purple: #5B2D8E, purpleDark: #3D1D5E, purpleLight: #F3EDF9, purpleMid: #7B4BAE, green: #28A745, orange: #FF9800, red: #DC3545, dark: #1A1A2E, text: #374151, grey: #6B7280, border: #E0D6EC, bg: #F8F7FC)
Add Poppins font via Google Fonts CDN link in index.html. Set body font-family to 'Poppins, sans-serif' in index.css

Create project directory structure: src/components/ (shared UI), src/components/layout/ (Sidebar, TopBar), src/pages/ (page-level components), src/data/ (seed data and store), src/hooks/ (custom hooks), src/utils/ (helpers), src/assets/ (logo SVG)
Copy the propela-logo-black.svg from design-reference/Propela Ops/assets/ into src/assets/

Create src/data/store.js - a localStorage-backed data store with: initializeStore() that checks if data exists in localStorage, getNurses()/setNurses(), getCohorts()/setCohorts(), getOrganisations()/setOrganisations(). Use JSON serialization. Key prefix 'propela_ops_'

Create src/data/seedData.js - generate 67 realistic seed nurse records for Cohort 1 following the PRD Section 7.7 field spec. Each nurse should have: id, fullName, preferredName, email, contactNumber, gender, ageGroup, province, city, registeredWithSANC, registeredNurseInSA, sancNumber, sancApcExpiry, sancApcStatus, highestQualification, qualificationInstitution, yearsOfClinicalExperience, primaryClinicalSpecialty, additionalCertifications, employmentStatus, currentEmployer, validPassport, passportExpiry, previouslyTakenEnglishTest, efSetScore (0-100), efSetLevel, englishPts, englishProficiencyLevel, oetStatus, oetExamDate, oetWritingScore, oetSpeakingScore, oetListeningScore, oetReadingScore, oetOverallResult, retakeRequired, retakeComponents, scorecard (hospitalExp, sancStatus, englishProficiency, qualifications, specialisation, validPassport, financialReadiness, motivation), cvScore (auto-calculated), finalScore (auto-calculated), tier (auto-calculated), pipelineStage, shortlistDecision, firstInterviewDate, nonSelectionReason, recommendedPathway, cohortAssigned, agreementSent, agreementSigned, commitmentFeeStatus, commitmentFeeDate, placementStatus, destinationCountry, photoUrl, nextAction, readinessStatus (auto-calculated from pipelineStage), flags (count from notes), motivations, questions, notes, source, communicationLog, submittedAt, lastContacted. Distribute nurses across pipeline stages realistically: ~15 Applied, ~10 CV Submitted, ~8 CV+English Submitted, ~5 Under Review, ~8 Shortlisted Yes, ~4 Shortlisted Maybe, ~7 Not Selected, ~3 Didnt Qualify, ~4 Selected for Cohort/Confirmed, ~3 Training Active. Include 5-8 nurses with [FLAG] in their notes.

Create src/data/seedOrganisations.js - generate 108 Health Facility organisation records for the Acquisition Hub Track 1 seed. Fields: id, organisationName, organisationType ('Health Facility'), province, city, physicalAddress, primaryContactName, contactEmail, contactPhone, linkedinWebsite, currentStage, lastContactDate, nextFollowUpDate, preferredChannel, nursesSourced, internalRating, notes, tags, healthcareGroup, facilityType, overviewDescription, outreachApproach, infoSessionHeld, infoSessionDate, nursesAttendingInfoSession, nursesConvertedToApplicants. Distribute across all 9 SA provinces. Include Netcare, Life Healthcare, Mediclinic, Public, and Independent facilities.

Create src/data/constants.js - all dropdown options from the PRD: PIPELINE_STAGES (array of {value, label, category} for Application Funnel, Cohort Pipeline, Exit/Hold), NEXT_ACTION_OPTIONS, READINESS_STATUSES, GENDER_OPTIONS, AGE_GROUP_OPTIONS, QUALIFICATION_OPTIONS, EXPERIENCE_OPTIONS, SPECIALTY_OPTIONS, OET_STATUS_OPTIONS, COMMITMENT_FEE_OPTIONS, PLACEMENT_STATUS_OPTIONS, PROVINCE_OPTIONS (9 SA provinces), SOURCE_OPTIONS, SHORTLIST_OPTIONS, TIER_LABELS, SCORECARD_WEIGHTS

Create src/utils/calculations.js - helper functions: calculateCvScore(scorecard), calculateFinalScore(scorecard), calculateTier(finalScore), calculateReadinessStatus(pipelineStage), getNextActionColour(nextAction, followUpDate), getFlagCount(notes)

Set up React Router in src/App.jsx with routes: / (Dashboard - placeholder), /nurses (Nurse Database), /nurses/:id (Nurse Card), /cohorts (Cohort Manager - placeholder), /acquisition (Acquisition Hub - placeholder), /templates (Template Library - placeholder). Include the sidebar layout wrapper.

Create src/components/layout/Sidebar.jsx - desktop sidebar navigation matching the admin-dashboard.jsx design: gradient purple background (#5B2D8E to #3D1D5E), Propela logo at top, nav items with Lucide icons (LayoutDashboard, Users, FolderKanban, Building2, FileText), active state highlighting, Aya avatar at bottom. Use React Router NavLink for active state.
Create src/components/layout/Layout.jsx - main layout wrapper with Sidebar on left (width 220px) and content area on right that fills remaining space with overflow-auto
Verify: Run npm run build successfully with no errors. Run npm run dev and confirm the app shell loads with sidebar navigation visible.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes without errors
npm run dev serves the app successfully
Navigating to /nurses route shows the Nurse Database page (even if placeholder content)
Sidebar shows 5 navigation items with Lucide icons and active state highlighting
localStorage contains 67 nurse records and 108 organisation records after first load
All calculation utilities produce correct values (cvScore, finalScore, tier, readinessStatus)
verification: Run 'npm run build' and confirm exit code 0
Run 'npm run dev' in background, then curl localhost:5173 to confirm HTML response
